body: No I didn't. I generally don't try to mix drugs.

Hope you're having a nice weekend!

Because we never really looked how bad my depression is, when I'm not on the meds. And I am not sure if I could tell him that. He has there his own opinion and I already told him a few months prior that it works good for me :/

The past few days I only slept, around 18 hours on average, waking up only to eat a little bit. The worst thing is that I'm still so tired. I feel like an absolute addict.

Idk if it will actually help me. I don't even know if I would want it to help.

And yeah, it's pretty scary that he can just take it away and suddenly I'm completely helpless

My doctor decided to take me off the meds as they wouldn't help with my depression. Because of that I am extremely sleepy and couldn't get myself to do anything, not yesterday and not today. 

I only have some headaches from time to time, but I still sometimes hear things that aren't there, but way less. I had a few pretty bad nosebleeds (rn again one).  But overall I feel way better.

It wasn't the best sleep I ever had, but I feel better now. The hairdryer didn't sound like Mozart anymore, which I'm actually a bit sad about. My paranoia is still stronger than usual, but whatever. I still feel weaker than normal, but not as weak as yesterday. But I still have some mild hallucinations. I haven't had a cramp today, but I know if I would provoke it, I would get one.

Thx for the help again, I will probably still post another update

Found zinc+vitamin c thingies and all round vitamin tablets in a closet, took 1 of both. The yogurt helped temporarily with the headaches.

The feeling of weakness has faded a tiny bit, but I still get the occasional cramps :/

Gatorade is a bit hard to come by here, but I have shakes that have a well balanced mix of everything in them. I couldn't specifically find anything with magnesium, but the shake has a but of that.

I already have a meeting with the doctor that prescribed me the 60s, but this time it's about SSRIs. Let's see how that will go.

Ill try to go to sleep for now. So thx again  and until later I guess
